entities.name: Guanahatabey and Ciboney Early Peoples
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The earliest inhabitants of Cuba, the Guanahatabey (also called Ciboney), were hunter-gatherers and shell-collectors who occupied the western part of the island. They lived in caves and rock shelters, leaving behind significant archaeological evidence.
